card.name: Slots where a fixed phrase continues
card.fires_on: Responds to the letter A in CYP3A, and to the word "or" in "with or without food". Also fires on a few other predictable mid-phrase slots, such as "Type 1" and "viv-ax".

modes.label: CYP3A enzyme name
modes.description: The letter A ending CYP3 before 4 or another enzyme name.
modes.example: BIC is a substrate of CYP3<<A>> and UGT1A1.

modes.label: With or without food
modes.description: The word "or" after "with" in food-intake instructions.
modes.example: MEKTOVI may be taken with<< or>> without food

modes.label: Other fixed phrase parts
modes.description: Partway through species names, type numbers or legal phrases.
